tests.message: Animated SVG export is not available on this plan. Requires the Starter plan.

tests.limitation: a static export is the first frame only (chevrons not drawn yet) and the rect origin is exported at the transform origin; not usable as an end state

consequence: Animated SVG, Lottie, React Native and video/GIF exports need a paid plan (Starter/Pro). No purchase was made (0 €). Micro-animations are delivered as hand-written CSS/SVG (web) with a Reanimated specification (Android), rendered and recorded with Chromium; the SVGator project stays editable for a later paid export if the owner decides so.
